basic_profile.bio: Based in the Isle of Man, I’m a delivery driver by day and an avid wrestling fan by night. I have a keen interest in the cultural heritage of Scotland, hence my fascination with kilts. I spend a lot of my downtime catching up on WWE storylines and discussing wrestling theories. I’m single and enjoy the freedom it brings to pursue my hobbies. My typical online hours are in the evenings, after work, when I can relax and engage with my favorite communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep knowledge of wrestling history and current events, largely self-taught through years of watching matches and reading wrestling forums. I also have a practical understanding of local logistics and delivery operations, gained through my job as a delivery driver.
